_about: Synthetic GEO measurement batch in the EviMed row shape (snapshot + facts + the question's pool and group). The expected output next to it was produced by running the owner's private compute_metrics.py on this batch through the adapter below; the script itself is not in this repository.

adapter.question: questionId
adapter.repeat_kind: 'noise' for roundKind noise, 'ec_confirm' for roundKind confirm, else ''
adapter.self_mentions: sum(brand.count for brand in facts.brands if brand.ours)
adapter.rival_mentions: {brand.name: brand.count for brand in facts.brands if brand.competitor and brand.count > 0}
adapter.drug_entity_mentions: sum(brand.count for brand in facts.brands) (registered + unregistered entities)
adapter.brand_sequence: names of registered brands (ours or competitor) with count > 0, by position
adapter.citations[]: {url, domain (lowercased), in_body: inBody, owned: isOurCitation(citation, owned) (host == an owned domain or ends with '.' + it, as extract_facts.py 3.0.1; or canonical URL in owned.urls), display: engines[engine].citation_display}
adapter.owned_citation_domains: sorted distinct domains of citations where isOurCitation
adapter.candidate_assertions + adjudication: each facts.statements[] item -> assertion {assertion_id: sha256(text)[:16], text} + adjudication {assertion_id, verdict}
adapter.entity_index.owned_domains: owned.domains + the hosts of owned.urls (registered <=> either list non-empty)
adapter.missing facts: a refusal without a facts row is an empty facts row (no mention, no retrieval); suspect/failed rows carry no facts
